g.text: Scenario - interrupted organization and evidence-based recovery
Organize was recorded as Pending before interruption.
Its intended after condition says Organized, with fingerprint H-report.
A separate tracked file record may not yet exist.
One logical confirmation; no second move is requested.
[both exist, neither exists, content differs, or inspection fails]
Preserve any existing copies. Do not select one to delete.
D abbreviates the fictional Downloads Folder. Source and destination are location roles, not software components.
This scenario concerns Organize. An interrupted Recycle cannot be confirmed from source disappearance alone.
